- 치열한 현실 속에서도 당신의 성장을 완벽히 책임지는 스마트 케어 시스템

top_apps.description_excerpt:
This is a simulation game intended for entertainment purposes only.

For users aged 18 and over.

This game does not involve real-money gambling and does not offer any opportunity to win real money, cash prizes, or real-world rewards.

All virtual coins, chips, credits, bonuses, and rewards are fictional and can only be used within the game.

No purchases or gameplay outcomes can be exchanged for money or items of value.

Success in this simulation game does not imply future success in real-money gambling.

【How to play】
One standard 52-card deck (no jokers), four players at the table.

Each player starts with 7 cards. The rest form the stock; one card opens the discard pile.

On your turn, draw from the stock or take the top discard.
After drawing, you may lay melds from your hand:
• Set: 3–4 cards of the same rank
• Run: 3+ consecutive cards of the same suit

End every turn by discarding exactly one card.
The first player to empty their hand wins the round and scores the deadwood left in opponents’ hands (A=1, face cards=10, others face value).
First to 100 practice points wins the match.

Become a powerful spider rope hero with incredible super abilities and protect the city from dangerous gangsters, mafia bosses, and violent criminals. Swing across skyscrapers, climb massive buildings, perform super jumps, and fight enemies in thrilling superhero battles.

Explore a huge modern 3D open-world city filled with highways, rooftops, traffic, hidden locations, and exciting missions. Every street is packed with crime, action, and rescue challenges waiting for a real hero. Use your amazing rope powers to move quickly across the city, chase criminals, save innocent civilians, and restore peace to the streets.

Experience realistic rope swinging mechanics and smooth superhero controls that make every mission more exciting. Catch enemies using powerful rope attacks, perform aerial combat moves, and defeat dangerous crime gangs using advanced fighting skills. Drive fast sports cars, ride bikes, and explore the city freely in this action-packed superhero simulator.

top_apps.name: Goose & Cook
top_apps.description_short: Build your own shop with Adorable Geese!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Build the World's Best Café with Adorable Geese!

A little goose who has always dreamed of owning a café has finally opened its very first shop!

But running a café for the first time isn't easy.
Orders get mixed up, meals turn into disasters, and the clumsy goose staff are constantly in a flurry.
Help them overcome their mistakes and build the ultimate café!

Research delicious dishes from both Eastern and Western cuisines, hire a team of charming goose employees, and grow your café into a thriving business.
Join these lovable, quirky geese and turn a humble café into the most popular destination in town!
